text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...
choice_data_list: Alright, double-unders!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Okay……gh!
……Ngh!"
Aiming for the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, Daring Heart began training with even higher intensity than before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...*phew*.
choice_data_list: Good work, let's head to the uphill course once you catch your breath.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
......Phew.
choice_data_list: ...Shall we extend our break time?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
I'll gladly take you up on that this time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm the one who said it,
when it comes to challenging a GⅠ after all...
the menu really is harsh.
choice_data_list: Your times have been steadily improving to match.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
...Little by little.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Heart-san~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!
I'm sorry, am I interrupting something...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I'm totally fine.
Are you heading to training now, Craft?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I'm gonna go hit the uphill slope!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hey! In that case—

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Craft and Heart are training together?!
Those two are the ones to watch this year!
Maybe I'll stick around and watch.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Thanks for putting up with my selfishness.
choice_data_list: No... more importantly, why all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I have wonderful classmates from my generation, but Craft is—special, even among them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
There's no denying her great ability.
But that's not the only reason I'm conscious of her—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: She's a "Pace" type, just like me.

Umamusume running styles can be broadly split into four categories:
"Front Runner," "Pacesetter," "Late Bloomer," and "Chaser"—
Among them, front-runners shape the pace of the race from the leading pack. Many have good starts and possess the stamina to sustain a strong finishing kick for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I heard she's running in the Hanshin JF too. That means—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Can she surpass Craft, who runs the exact same way...?
That will be her very first,
and greatest wall to overcome.
choice_data_list: (In the mock race before debut—)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Not yet!!
I'm going to win this...!!
choice_data_list: (――Craft won the duel.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Right then!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Craft!
—Shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Heart & Craft
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

Both got off to a good start.
Daring Heart pulled slightly ahead right away.
However, that didn't last long—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haaah............!!
Further... ahead!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
choice_data_list: (Heart came late...?!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san, thank you for racing me!
Well then, see you back in the classroom!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible, Rhein Kraft!
She can sustain a great pace for so long,
and her final kick was razor-sharp!

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart was good, but...
Honestly, she was completely outmatched...

—The buzz around her could not be denied.
Rhein Kraft smoothly moved to the front, perfectly pacing herself into the final spurt.
In other words, despite being in the Junior class, she's already approaching the ideal form for a front-runner...
choice_data_list: ...Heart—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Total defeat.
A complete loss, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You truly are strong...
Rhein Kraft...

Daring Heart watched her rival walk away.
Yet in her eyes, rather than frustration,
there seemed to be a look of pure admiration.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Then I—
After finishing up all the training—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
—Why don't you change your running style?
choice_data_list: Huh...!

text_block_list.text: "Changing one's running style... There are many interpretations, but in this case, it likely refers to changing running strategies. That's because—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Watching Craft run, you probably
thought so too, didn't you?
That even among front-runners, she's on a whole other level.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Even if I stick to my current running style, I won't reach Craft...
If that's the case, I need to change something drastically.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't get me wrong, okay?
It's not that I lack confidence.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If anything—please understand that this proposal
is specifically to ensure victory at the Hanshin JF.
choice_data_list: But... that means throwing away the way you've run until now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Right.
My running."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The precious running style that I built at Hill-Esta
Academy and have polished all this way...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
――I'm leaving it behind.
I don't care if you throw it away!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's all to win, so my mind's made up.
So—won't you think of something for me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A new running style that lets me shine brightest.
So, what do you think?

Her running is by no means bad. However,
considering the current situation... it seems worth researching
a style that suits her even better.
choice_data_list: Got it. Let's try all sorts of things!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now that's what I expect, my partner!
Make sure to dress me in the most brilliant radiance!
So starting the next day, I had Daring Heart try out various running styles.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... this high pace...!
I can't keep it up...!
choice_data_list: (Speed to front-run away... hmm.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Sp-Spurting from here...!?
Kgh.........!
choice_data_list: (I won't have enough left in my legs to make a late surge...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...! Haaaah...!!
choice_data_list: (My closing run isn't bad! But...)

text_block_list.text:
She didn't seem very lively.
Every running style looked awkward for her,
and it felt like none brought out her true strengths.
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it— what is Heart's greatest strength, anyway?)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how is it...?
Which one was the best?
choice_data_list: Hmm... if you ask for the best one...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Not feeling it, huh?
...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You've gathered all the data, haven't you?
Then analyze it in your own way, please.
choice_data_list: Yeah, give me a little time.
Yeah, give me a little time.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Gate 1, Number 1: Daring Heart.
She is drawing the most attention today.
Next up, Gate 2, Number 2—"

How should Daring Heart run from now on?
To reach a conclusion, I decided to review
all of her past races once again, and then—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Hah... hah...!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Daring Heart moves up into third place. She's pushing the pace from a favorable position."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu... Everyone!
Follow me!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "I am today's—Queen!"
"I was captivated by that brilliance. Running out front, so lively and imposing... Daring Heart pulling the lead pack."

Looking back, it was the same in her debut race.
Whenever she decided to take the lead,
she ran with so much life and energy.
choice_data_list: (The way she can shine the brightest when running is—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —I knew it, she's still here!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I thought you'd say that!
I brought you a midnight snack—
choice_data_list: Heart, got it
Heart, I get it now

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You've found the answer, haven't you?
So—how should I run?!
choice_data_list: You should—run as a front runner!
You should—run as a Pace Setter/Leader!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Right, a front-runner!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……What!?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer, hello~!
Everyone's already gathered!
choice_data_list: Thank you all for cooperating.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Duh, that's totally obvious!
I mean, it's for my Heart, right?
Then I'd do anything!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text: "We just have to do a regular mock race, right?"
choice_data_list: Yeah. And as for your heart—
Yeah. So, how's your heart—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We'll run near the front, just like always.
—And ahead of everyone else, at that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Knowing you,
I'm sure you have a strategy in mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Just because you have time doesn't mean it's infinite, you know?
choice_data_list: It's okay. I'm sure— they'll understand

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haa... ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Heart is crazy...!
She's pushing right to the front...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: (I'm getting pressured from behind, and I have to keep up with the pace up front... Honestly, it's exhausting! ...But—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha!
Awesome!
choice_data_list: (Right, the heart... this is fine.)

text_block_list.text:
Boldly taking the lead and dictating the race—
surging forward at the front as her heart dictates is how she brings out her greatest strength.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haa... whew...
choice_data_list: Good work, Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Okay, I'll admit it.
—I was able to run with everything I had!"
choice_data_list: You were shining brighter than ever before!
You were shining brighter than ever before!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Really?
...Right, in other words..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I just love taking the lead!
From start to finish, I want to keep pushing forward and forward.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Staying unchanged is what's best for me.
I understand that, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well then, that doesn't solve any problems at all.
Because with the exact same running style, Craft is superior—
choice_data_list: No. What you're lacking isn't ability
No. What you're lacking isn't ability

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Huh?
What do you mean?"
choice_data_list: What you're lacking is the "skill to have fun."
What you're lacking is the "skill to have fun."

text_block_list.text: With her extraordinary instincts, Rhein Kraft brings out the absolute best of her abilities. Yet, Daring Heart doesn't. Why is that?
choice_data_list: —It's because you're burning through too much stamina.
—Because you're burning through too much stamina.

text_block_list.text: To seize the initiative in a race, you not only need to maintain your speed, but also the power to keep pushing forward, and the tactical mind to anticipate other Umamusume—

With complex factors intertwining, it drains more stamina
than running normally. If that's the case,
if she could run while expending less energy than now—
choice_data_list: If you perform at your absolute best, you can stand shoulder to shoulder with Craft!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Still, how will you reduce the fatigue?
It's not like you have an idea right now, do you?"
choice_data_list: ...You don't believe me?
...You don't believe me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Trust me... Could you give me some time to come up with a plan?
Believe in me... won't you give me time to work out a plan?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
Why are you asking such a thing with a face like that?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course I believe you. I'm counting on you,
—my clever little analyst!
